# Fix the Verification Flow — Request for 2 Sprints

**To:** VP, Engineering · **From:** Product · **Date:** 2026-06-01
**Ask:** Approve 2 sprints to add status feedback and completion notifications to bank verification.

## The problem in one line
New merchants finish signup, hit a **3-business-day bank-verification wait with zero feedback**, conclude the product is broken, and quit — *one step before going live.*

## Where it breaks
Maya, a first-time small-business owner, makes it all the way through provider selection and KYC. Then she waits. No timeline, no confirmation her documents were received, no status. This is the **make-or-break moment of the entire setup** — and right now it silently fails.

> "Is this broken?" — the wait turns anxiety into doubt, and doubt into abandonment.

## Cost of inaction
- **Highest-impact drop-off in the funnel.** A large share of owners abandon here — at the last step before first payment, after they've already done all the work.
- **We lose them at peak intent and peak sunk cost.** Every abandon is a merchant who was *ready to transact* and walked — recurring revenue lost, not a one-time miss.
- **Acquisition spend wasted.** We pay to bring merchants through selection and KYC, then forfeit them in a waiting screen we control.
- **It compounds.** The wait is regulatory and unavoidable; the *silence* is not. Every week we don't ship this, the funnel keeps leaking at its widest crack.

## The fix (scoped to 2 sprints)
| What | Effort | Impact |
|---|---|---|
| In-flow status feedback: expected timeline, "documents received" confirmation, step-by-step progress | Medium | High |
| Proactive notification (email/SMS) when verification completes | Low | High |

Both target the same step. Neither shortens the bank's verification time — they remove the *information vacuum* that makes a normal wait feel like a failure.

## Why now
The waiting state is the single largest, most addressable leak in onboarding. The fix is well-understood, fits in 2 sprints, and converts users who have *already shown they want to pay us.*

**Decision requested:** Approve 2 sprints to ship verification-flow status feedback + completion notifications.

*Source: "First-time online payments setup" journey map (step `connect-bank-account`). Figures are qualitative pending instrumentation — recommend adding drop-off tracking in sprint 1 to quantify recovery.*
